newsitem.title: USA: Xytronyx treatment effective in rats.
newsitem.headline: Xytronyx treatment effective in rats.

text.p: Xytronyx Inc Tuesday said its proprietary immunotherapy treatment has shown positive results in a recent animal study as an effective treatment for the destruction of malignant tumors in rats.

The company said a study reported in the current issue of Cancer Letters shows the PDIT technology destroyed targeted tumors in both primary and metastatic tumors, minimizing local nontumor tissue damage, and created resistance in successfully treated rats to tumor rechallenge.

The treatment, to which Xytronyx has a worldwide exclusive license, consists of the co-injection of a photosensitizing drug and an immunoadjuvant directly into a tumor followed by illumination with an infrared laser. The photosensitizer laser treatment is designed to provide highly selective tissue destruction and in combination with the immunoadjuvant is intended to stimulate a long lasting immune response, it said.
